# Assent Steel

> ASSENT STEEL INDUSTRIES L.L.C is a leading structural steel fabricator and erector based in Dubai Industrial City, UAE, delivering steel engineering, fabrication, blasting/painting/fireproofing, and erection services to industrial, commercial, and infrastructure projects across the UAE, GCC, USA, UK, Africa, and Australia since 2008.

# Detailed Content


## Pages

> Assent is a leading steel company in Dubai, serving the GCC and global markets. Trusted for high-quality steel solutions with international project expertise.

- URL: https://www.assentsteel.com/

ASSENT STEEL INDUSTRIES L.L.C is introduced as a leading steel fabricator, delivering high-quality products globally since its founding in 2008. Four core services are highlighted: Engineering (structural design, connection design, and BIM coordination), Fabrication (CNC-driven cutting, forming, and shaping), Blasting, Painting & Fire Proofing (epoxy, polyurethane, and zinc-rich coating systems meeting international fire-safety codes), and Steel Erection (on-site installation supported by lifting studies and detailed coordination). Project categories showcased include Commercial, Industrial Oil & Gas, and Data Centre projects, with named commercial projects including Dubai International Airport Expansion, Cargo Mega Terminal, Coca-Cola Arena, Kuwait International Airport, a Tennis Complex, Al Maktoum Stadium, Emirates International School, and Abu Dhabi Plaza. Client/partner logos displayed include Bechtel. Sustainability is described as central to how the company builds and operates, with five core focus areas: Environmental, Health & Safety, Community, Diversity, and Ethics. The Head Office is listed as Dubai Industrial City, UAE (P.O. Box 38436), phone +971 4 247 1200, emails info@assentsteel.com and contactus@assentsteel.com.


> Discover Assent Steel, a Dubai-based steel manufacturing company delivering dependable manufacturing, supply & installation solutions with consistent quality.

- URL: https://www.assentsteel.com/about

Describes ASSENT STEEL as one of the largest structural steel fabricators and suppliers in Dubai and the UAE, having expanded operations beyond the GCC to serve clients across the USA, UK, Africa, and Australia, with a proven track record in high-rise buildings, industrial plants, and the energy sector. The company operates a high-capacity, state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Dubai Industrial City capable of producing up to 120,000 tons of steel structures per year, and positions itself as a "One-Stop-Shop" for structural steel — specializing in hot-rolled structural steel fabrication and cold-formed cladding systems with full design-build integration from concept to completion.

A company history timeline runs from 2008 through 2025:
- 2008 — Company established; fabrication yard spans 2.7 million sq ft (1.1 million sq ft fully covered), housing the UAE's largest single collection of advanced CNC machinery.
- 2012 — Qurayyah Power Plant: supplied and fabricated 22,000 tons of structural steel for Samsung C&T in Saudi Arabia (a gas-fired Independent Power Producer facility with 12 gas turbines and 12 heat recovery units).
- 2014 — Abu Dhabi Plaza: supply, fabrication, and installation of 21,000 tons of structural steel for a landmark mixed-use development in Astana, Kazakhstan.
- 2016 — Doha Metro Phase 1: supplied, fabricated, and installed 11,200 tons of structural steel for Qatar Rail in partnership with Fujita Corporation, covering a fully operational, driverless 86.23 km metro network.
- 2018 — Established ASSENT STEEL Profiles (ASP), a dedicated sandwich panel and light-gauge factory; PUF panels achieved FM Approval fire-rating certification.
- 2020 — Awarded a landmark contract by Hitachi Zosen Inova for the supply, fabrication, and installation of 14,000 tons of structural steel for the Dubai Waste Management Center.
- 2021 — ASSENT STEEL Expands Global Footprint: established a dedicated USA office as part of the company's strategic international expansion.
- 2023 — Multiple project milestones: first USA project delivered (Synloop Ammonia Plant with OSBL Utilities, Beaumont); Chiyoda Manyar Smelter Project completed (17,000 tons); LOR Pure Data Centre completed (2,300 tons); Hitachi West Field delivered.
- 2024 — 2024 statistics reported: 97,296 tons raw material received; 75,132 tons sizing; 70,225 tons fabrication; 9,025 tons fireproofing; 60,912 tons painting; 69,609 tons delivered.
- 2025 — New and completed projects: Velodrome completed (~5,000 tons); Canada projects started December 2024; Thacker Pass USA project production started.

Stated company values: Safety, Quality, We Deliver, Integrity, Financial Responsibility, Learning, Sustainability, Relationships, and Data.


> Looking for reliable steel engineering services? We offer structural design & engineering support for industrial & commercial projects across the GCC & beyond.

- URL: https://www.assentsteel.com/steel-engineering-services

Covers ASSENT STEEL's structural steel engineering capability: member and connection design, 3D modelling, and BIM coordination using advanced modelling software, aligned to international design codes and U.S. safety/quality standards. Comprehensive services include: design of statical (load-bearing) systems, connection design, 3D modelling for clash detection, material take-offs, preparation of GA and fabrication drawings, coordination with other trades (MEP and architectural), and value engineering/design proposals. The team builds full 3D project models (from 2D drawings or continuing from existing Tekla-format models) with live model access for clients. Software stack: STAAD.Pro, ETABS, and SAP for structural member design; IDEA Statica, RAM Connection, Master Key, and LIMCON for connection design; Fastrak P-Frame 2D/3D and MBS for portal frame and pre-engineered building design; Tekla (X-Steel) for 3D modelling/detailing; AutoCAD for 2D detailing. Stated differentiators: 17+ years of expertise, a team of over 1,250 engineers, detailers, and project managers (120+ engineering professionals), 250+ projects delivered across UAE, USA, UK, Africa, Europe, and Southeast Asia, and a 2.7 million sq ft facility with 120,000 tonnes/year production capacity.


> Assent Steel is a premier steel fabrication company in Dubai, UAE, providing reliable, global steel solutions across various sectors.

- URL: https://www.assentsteel.com/steel-fabrication-services

Describes the fabrication facility (2.7 million sq ft, up to 120,000 tons/year) and its CNC machinery: CNC-SAW machine (bandsaw cutting up to 1250x600mm at 90°, 800x600mm at 45°, 500x500mm at 60°), CNC-drilling, plate processing machines, laser cutting, portable machines, and plasma cutting — supporting sawing, drilling, coping, plate processing, angle mastering, and profiling. Fabrication bays include 11 regular bays, 2 jumbo structure bays, and 2 trussel bays, supported by overhead cranes and electric trolley systems. Stated differentiators: precision fabrication with minimal tolerance deviation, multi-stage quality control inspections, certified international welding standards, scalable production capacity, modern CNC/plasma/laser/automated beam-line machinery, and an experienced workforce delivering projects across the Middle East, Europe, Africa, Asia, and North America.


> Assent provides professional steel blasting, paint coating, & fireproofing services designed to improve durability, corrosion protection, & fire safety performance.

- URL: https://www.assentsteel.com/steel-blasting-painting-fire-proofing

Covers the facility's blasting, painting, and fireproofing operations: 50,000 sq m of dedicated raw material storage (up to 40,000 tons of steel sections) and 30,000 sq m of fully covered blasting/painting area. Painting systems include epoxy, polyurethane, and zinc-rich primers, providing defense against rust, chemical attack, UV degradation, and physical abrasion. Fireproofing solutions are engineered to global safety standards to preserve structural integrity and extend safe evacuation time during a fire, applied across industrial, commercial, and residential developments. Processes follow ISO and SSPC (Society for Protective Coatings) standards. Services are delivered for projects across the UAE, North America, Europe, Africa, and Australia.


> Assent Steel delivers expert steel erection services for commercial & industrial projects, trusted for safe execution & on-site efficiency worldwide.

- URL: https://www.assentsteel.com/steel-erection-services

Covers ASSENT STEEL's on-site structural steel erection capability, with over a decade of erection experience and the capacity to install up to 4,000 tonnes of structural steel per month, supported by high-capacity cranes and advanced equipment. The erection process is described in four stages: establishing the foundation based on project needs, lifting and placing components into position, aligning the structure and packing the connections, and securing/imparting rigidity to the frame. Notable referenced projects include Coca-Cola Arena in Dubai, Kuwait International Airport, and Mohammed Bin Rashid Library, including lifts of over 5,000 tons of steel for large-scale stadiums. Stated differentiators: end-to-end capabilities from design through erection, on-time delivery under tight schedules, diverse project experience across industrial, commercial, infrastructure, and energy sectors, strict adherence to global safety/QA-QC standards, and advanced tech integration (BIM, CNC, ERP systems) for planning, fabrication, and tracking transparency.


> ASSENT STEEL has a committed Sustainability policy to reducing the environmental & sustainability risk level in all our operations.

- URL: https://www.assentsteel.com/sustainability

States that sustainability defines how ASSENT STEEL operates, innovates, and grows, from material procurement and production efficiency to workforce welfare and community engagement, with a stated commitment to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (UN SDGs) and UAE Vision 2030. The company integrates ESG principles within its Integrated Management System (IMS), maintaining compliance with ISO 9001 (Quality), ISO 14001 (Environment), and ISO 45001 (Occupational Health & Safety), and aligns with ISO 14064-1 and the GHG Protocol Corporate Standard, maintaining a Scope 1, 2, and 3 greenhouse gas inventory consistent with UAE Net Zero 2050 goals. Downloadable resources include a Sustainability Policy PDF, an EPD (Environmental Product Declaration) report, and an HPD (Health Product Declaration) report.

Five core focus areas: Environment (efficient resource management, energy/carbon reduction, closed-loop water systems, waste management, and support for LEED/EPD/HPD-certified green product development), Health & Safety, Community, Diversity, and Ethics. Social responsibility initiatives include collaboration with schools and training centers, career opportunities for young talent, and a strong workplace safety culture; other stated initiatives cover prioritizing employee safety/rights/wellbeing, supporting health and humanitarian causes, community outreach, learning and skill development, reducing carbon footprint through smart mobility, and building green to global standards.

> Join Assent Steel's growing team across the GCC and beyond. Explore career opportunities in steel fabrication, engineering, and project delivery.

- URL: https://www.assentsteel.com/careers

Careers page inviting applications across experience levels, highlighting sustainability/ethics alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, strong core values, employee well-being, professional development opportunities, and an innovation/growth-driven culture. Staff care themes include career growth, team collaboration, work-life balance, and safety/quality commitment. Sample current openings listed (roles rotate): Welder (Dubai), Estimator (Abu Dhabi), Project Manager (Bahrain), QA/QC Inspector (Oman), Structural Engineer (Saudi Arabia), and Steel Fabrication Supervisor (Kuwait) — reflecting the company's GCC-wide hiring footprint. Applications are submitted via an online form (name, date of birth, gender, position, CV upload up to 5MB in PDF/DOC/DOCX).
